   - General category candidates must score at least 50% in the qualifying examination (Physics, Chemistry, and Biology combined).
   - SC/ST/OBC candidates need a minimum of 40%.
   - Persons with disabilities in the General category must score at least 45%.

4. **Nationality**: Eligibility is extended to Indian citizens, NRIs, Overseas Citizens of India (OCIs), Persons of Indian Origin (PIOs), and Foreign Nationals.
